billingFaqs.question: Can I switch plans anytime?
billingFaqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect from the next billing cycle.

billingFaqs.question: Is there a free trial?
billingFaqs.answer: We offer a 7-day free trial for all plans. No payment details required.

billingFaqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
billingFaqs.answer: We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), all major credit/debit cards, net banking, and EMI options through Razorpay.

billingFaqs.question: Can I get a refund?
billingFaqs.answer: Full refund within 14 days of subscription. Pro-rated refunds after 14 days as per our refund policy.

billingFaqs.question: Are there sibling or group discounts?
billingFaqs.answer: Yes! Enroll 2 or more siblings and get 15% off each subscription. Group discounts available for schools and coaching centers.
